test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the length of the longest pole that can be placed in a room of dimensions 10 m × 10 m × 5 m?
solution:
Given:

The dimension of the room = 10 m × 10 m × 5 m 

Concept used:

The length of the longest rod = The diagonal of the cuboid

Diagonal of the cuboid = sqrt{ l² + b² + h² } 

Where, 

l → Length of the cuboid 

b → Breadth of the cuboid 

h → Height of the cuboid 

Calculations:

The length of the longest rod will be the diagonal of the cuboid

⇒ √225 = 15 m.

∴ The length of the longest rod in the room is 15 m.
